title: Unique Crispy Malaysian Corn Satay
description: A funky and crispy Malaysian dish featuring fine yellow cornmeal, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for any occasion. It is a raw-friendly dish that is broiled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, coconut milk, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder until well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the mixture to chill.
Remove the bowl from the refrigerator and stir the mixture again.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Broil the corn satay for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the corn satay from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Unique Crispy Malaysian Corn Satay warm and enjoy.
